196215: A B-rank adventurer from the nearby settlement of Zoltan, Rit is a long-time associate of Gideon. Upon hearing about Red from the adventurer's guild, she wonders whether it's actually Gideon and visits the newly opened pharmacy. She ends up living there and helping out.
196216: A member of the Hero's party, Ares is blessed with the sign of the 'Leader'. While his intellect and magical aptitude allow him to excel as a magician, he is also proud and incredibly ambitious. He ran Gideon out of the party and told others that he left of his own accord.
196217: Gideon's younger sister, Ruti is blessed with the sign of the 'Hero', she is destined to slay the Demon Lord. This has granted her unimaginable power, yet also inhibits her emotions and very humanity as these are unnecessary for a hero.
196218: A D-rank adventurer from the nearby settlement of Zoltan, Red gathers and sells herbs to make a living and hopes to one day open his own herb shop and live a quiet life.
204987: A high elf, fellow veteran and close friend of Gideon, Yarandrala was born in the Kingdom of Kiramin and is blessed with the sign of the 'Forest Speaker'. She is able to ask plants to lend her their aid.
206860: Gonzo's sister and Tanta's mother, Nao is a bright, personable woman who's been shipping Red and Rit ever since they started living together. She enjoys visiting saunas and drinking beer inside, but she's worried that the one Zeff runs isn't doing well.
206861: A doctor from a clinic in Zoltan, Newman is blessed with the sign of 'Fast Preparation' and is thus able to prepare any medicine in only an hour. Having diagnosed Tanta's White Eye Disease alongside Red, he's come to trust him.
206862: Servant to the church of Almighty Demis and instructor in the Temple Knights' Style of spearmanship, Theodora is a member of the Hero's party and blessed with the sign of the 'Crusader'.
206863: Tanta is the son of Gonzo's sister Nao and her husband Mido. Red has taken a liking to him. Although he does not yet know his blessing, he wants to be a carpenter like Gonzo. He suffers from a white-eye disease that may ultimately lead to blindness.
206864: Although just a nickname, Storm is a half-orc craftsman in charge of a furniture shop in downtown Zoltan. He's generally on good terms with Red.
206865: A rare B-rank adventurer from the nearby settlement of Zoltan, Albert is blessed with the sign of the 'Champion' that allows him to overcome great difficulties to achieve amazing feats. Aware of his gifts, he worries whether or not he is living up to them.
206866: A member of the Hero's party with the sign of the 'Martial Artist', Danan is the singular weapons master of his generation and joined on assumption that this was the fastest route to the Demon Lord's defeat.
226689: A half-elf carpenter working in the nearby settlement of Zoltan, Gonze is close with Red. He has the pleasant personality of a practiced craftsman and the know-how to boot. He looks after his sister's family living next door, and dotes on their son Tanta.
226690: Nao's husband and Tanta's father, Mido is a human rather than a half-elf. He has given up adventuring for carpentry. While not a skilled craftsman as Gonzo, he is quick with numbers and works well as in a supporting role.
240579: A receptionist for the adventurer's guild in Zoltan, Megria will occasionally purchase herbs gathered by Red. She has a strong trust of the competent and classy Red, who she suspects is hiding the fact that he is a powerful knight.
240580: A man blessed with the sign of the 'Fire Mage', Dir once provided guidance to Albert when he was looking for help defeating an owlbear that was abducting people. Although Gideon and Rit don't remember it, they once met him in a battle against the Demon Lord's forces in Loggervia.
246068: A petite girl with the sign of the 'Assassin', Tisse is a member of the Assassin's guild. She replaced the outcast Gideon in the Hero's party at the request of Ares. She has a small spider familiar named Uge-uge.
316348: Mohen is Ademi father and the chief of the town guards
319587: Another "hero". He is the 8th prince of the Kingdom of Flamberg, and after his homeland was destroyed by the Demon King's army, he became lonely for the rest of his life. He has a pure and innocent personality with a strong sense of justice, and is also deeply religious.
319588: A fairy from the hero's party who calls herself Van's partner. She holds great magical power in her small body. She hates humans, but Van is special to her, and she falls in love with him and joins his group.
319589: One of the cardinals who is the highest ranking official of the Holy Church. He becomes the guardian of Van, who has received the blessings of a "hero," and is taking various measures to help him grow as a hero.
319590: A masked knight hired as a mercenary by the hero's party. Her real name is Escalata, and she is entrusted with the support of the hero Van due to her experience in defeating one of the Four Heavenly Kings of the Demon King's Army.
